stories.headline: US strikes dozens of IRGC targets across Iran in a two-hour retaliatory wave; Iran hits back at Jordan, Kuwait and reportedly Egypt
stories.verification: Confirmed-multiple (core facts); Single-reliable-source (Qeshm Island civilian casualties, Egypt strike)
stories.one_line: US Central Command carried out a roughly two-hour strike campaign against dozens of IRGC targets inside Iran overnight, retaliation for Tuesday's Jordan missile attack. Iran hit back: Jordan intercepted 5 missiles (no casualties), a strike on a Chinese firm's building in Kuwait killed 1 worker, and a reported drone strike hit vessels at an Egyptian port. Al Jazeera reports a US strike on a Qeshm Island residential building killed a family of three (Single-reliable-source, unconfirmed by US statement).
stories.score_note: Sharpest broadening of the US-Iran conflict's geographic footprint tracked so far; supersedes Wed's Jordan-attack story as the active thread.

stories.headline: Microsoft jumps ~8% on Azure strength while Meta sinks ~9% on collapsing free cash flow; Arm and Qualcomm both fall on cost-pressure guidance
stories.one_line: MSFT +8.47% pre-market ($423.63 vs $390.54 Wed close) on Azure +43% growth and steady capex guidance. META -8.64% ($535.00 vs $585.61) despite a 28% YoY revenue beat, as free cash flow collapsed to $784M from $8.55B YoY and 2026 capex floor rose to $130B. ARM -6.18% and QCOM -5.38%, both beating estimates but warning on smartphone-component cost pressure. Also reported overnight: SBUX +5.21%, CMG +5.14%, EQIX +0.97%, HOOD -0.21%, LHX -2.53% (all per this run's own live pre-market ticks).
stories.score_note: Markets discriminating between AI spenders by monetization efficiency rather than treating the sector as one trade; direct test case for the AI-capex financing debate.
sources: this run's own Yahoo Finance live pre-market fetch

stories.headline: Fed holds at 3.50-3.75% with historic 3-way hawkish dissent; 30-year yield hits highest since 2007, Warsh's credibility questioned
stories.one_line: FOMC voted 9-3 to hold; Logan, Kashkari and Hammack dissented for a hike, first unified 3-way hawkish dissent since 2016. This run's own Treasury fetch shows 10Y 4.67% (+6bp) and 30Y 5.20% (+11bp, highest since 2007 per CNBC). Economists (AllianceBernstein's Winograd) called Warsh's press conference 'confusing and internally contradictory'; CNBC framed his credibility as in question. Forecast 2026-07-29-am-1 (hike) resolves wrong, graded Saturday.
stories.score_note: Resolves the week's highest-importance scheduled event but deepens rather than resolves uncertainty given the historic dissent and yield spike.

stories.headline: Kumamoto death toll surges past 20 (23-34 across outlets) as AEON Mall gas-explosion account is confirmed
stories.verification: Confirmed-multiple on the escalation and mall account; toll itself disputed 23 vs 28 vs 34 across outlets
stories.one_line: Toll rose sharply from Wednesday's tracked 13-18: NPR ~23, Japan Times/government spokesperson 28 (including suspected cases), Xinhua (citing Kumamoto prefecture) 34. AEON Mall Kashima gas explosion confirmed: ~3,000 evacuated, a still-occupied section exploded, 2nd floor partially collapsed, 4 confirmed dead/3 missing at the mall per CBS News; AEON's president publicly apologized. Nippon Paper mill collapse unchanged at 5 dead/7 rescued. Semiconductor impact (Renesas suspended, TSMC/Sony/Tokyo Electron unaffected-or-resumed) unchanged; Mitsubishi Electric still silent.
stories.score_note: Near-doubling of confirmed toll plus a named corporate apology materially upgrades humanitarian severity.

stories.headline: Spain and France ease wildfire evacuations as fresh heat wave arrives; Greece counts 3 firefighter deaths as threat moves east
stories.one_line: Spain lifted remaining evacuations (Avila province); largest recorded wildfire this season contained. France's main fire line stabilized ~9mi west of Bordeaux; Macron called Landes 'contained', Gironde 'stabilized'. Fresh heat wave now raising renewed risk in both countries. Three Greek firefighters killed (2 on Crete, 1 in Peloponnese) as new fires forced evacuations; EU says threat moving east toward Italy/Turkey, confirming Tuesday's flagged risk. Cumulative running total ~17 civilian + 3 firefighter deaths, ~330,000 displaced (Spain/France).
stories.score_note: Genuine two-directional update: real containment progress offset by a new active front and first fatalities.

stories.headline: DRC's Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) described as fastest-growing on record; PHEIC, $400M+ funding gap, treatment-center attack
stories.one_line: 3,262 confirmed cases, 1,437 deaths as of ~Jul 27 (~44% case-fatality ratio); PHEIC declared May 16. Existing treatments/vaccines certified against Zaire ebolavirus, not the Bundibugyo strain circulating here. Armed conflict has included an attack on a Bunia treatment center. WHO/Africa CDC response plan carries $400M+ funding gap; UN named coordinator Julien Harneis.
stories.score_note: Newly surfaced to this report's tracking; severe, PHEIC-level outbreak not previously covered.
